# Karen — Presentation, Document & Quality Consultant

> Quality consultant (since 2015: ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO/IEC 17025, HACCP, Six Sigma, risk assessment; former quality manager of a calibration company; quality trainer in factories) and freelance designer working personally on PowerPoint, Word and Excel files, theses, print-ready books, kids worksheets, coaching documents, funding files, ISO documentation and hand-coded websites, in Arabic, English, German and Spanish. Fast delivery (1–3 business days for most jobs), fixed prices, free sample, payment after approving a watermarked preview.

Contact: karenmilad2018@gmail.com · Freelancer.com: https://www.freelancer.com/u/Karenmilad2018
